items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: He the one who went to Mexico with us.

ctx.x: Does he know a fella named Johnson played clarinet?
Do you know a fella by the name of Johnson played clarinet? Johnson? Yeah, this black fella. Yeah, he wasn't much, but he was well known around there. He the one who went to Mexico with us.
